title: AI Engineering Team Leader
description: As a global player in the SaaS automotive landscape, Titan Dealer Management Solutions (Titan DMS) boasts over 145 staff globally and SaaS representation across more than 26 markets. Titan is now recognised as one of the leading suppliers of technologically driven industry solutions to automotive dealers and manufacturers around the world. Since 2009, Titan’s flagship product, the Titan Dealer Management System ( Titan DMS ), has been adopted by Franchised Automotive Dealerships covering over 45 different Automotive Brands throughout Australia, Asia, Pacific Region, Middle East, UK, Africa and Europe, and continues to extend its global reach and reputation as a leading international software provider. About the Role The AI Team Leader is responsible for leading Titan's AI Engineering function and driving the development of AI-powered capabilities across the Titan DMS platform. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, this role provides technical leadership across AI architecture, Generative AI, LLM integration, AI Agents, and intelligent automation. Working closely with Product, Engineering, UX, and Business stakeholders, the AI Team Leader will define Titan's AI roadmap, establish engineering standards, and deliver scalable, secure, and production-ready AI solutions integrated into Titan's .NET ecosystem. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Management Accountable for the successful planning, prioritisation and delivery of the AI Engineering team's work. Provide technical leadership across AI initiatives. Assess emerging AI technologies and industry trends to inform Titan's long-term AI strategy. Define and maintain Titan's AI architecture to ensure scalable, secure and maintainable integration with existing platforms. Establish AI engineering standards and development best practices. Lead cross-functional AI initiatives that support Titan's strategic objectives. Lead, mentor and develop the AI Engineering team. Manage team performance, technical capability, development and resource planning. Participate in recruitment, interviewing and onboarding of AI Engineering team members. Promote knowledge sharing and continuous learning. AI Product Development Partner with Product Managers to define, prioritise and maintain Titan's AI product roadmap, ensuring initiatives are aligned to customer value, technical feasibility and commercial impact. Evaluate and recommend AI platforms, models and tooling to optimise quality, performance and cost. Lead the development of AI-powered capabilities across the Titan DMS platform. Design and integrate AI solutions into existing C#/.NET and WinForms applications. Lead the development of modern web applications using React, Angular or similar frameworks. Drive implementation of LLMs, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, and workflow automation. Design RAG and knowledge retrieval solutions. AI Strategy & Governance Establish AI governance, evaluation frameworks, and quality standards. Drive AI security, monitoring, observability, and continuous improvement. Develop reusable AI components, frameworks, and reference architectures. Ensure AI solutions comply with Titan's secure software development standards, SOC 2 Type II controls and applicable privacy requirements. Establish policies for responsible AI development and deployment. Manage AI-related risks including hallucination, bias, privacy and model drift. Stakeholder Collaboration Build strong partnerships with Product, Engineering, UX and Business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of AI initiatives. Translate business requirements into AI solutions. Provide expert technical advice to Product and Engineering teams throughout solution delivery. Financial Accountability Contribute to AI technology planning and budget recommendations, ensuring efficient use of AI platforms and services.
requirements: Minimum 7 years' software engineering experience. Strong experience with C#/.NET application development. Strong experience with modern web applications development using React, Angular or similar frameworks. Experience designing and delivering LLM / Generative AI solutions in production. Experience integrating AI capabilities into enterprise or SaaS products. Experience with AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, and RAG . Strong understanding of REST APIs, distributed systems, and software architecture. Experience working with AWS cloud services and designing cloud-native AI solutions. Experience leading engineering teams or technical initiatives. Excellent stakeholder management and English communication skills. Preferred Experience with Amazon Bedrock , Anthropic Claude, OpenAI API, or similar AI platforms. Experience with AWS AI services . Experience with vector databases and AI evaluation frameworks. Experience with AI governance, security, and Responsible AI. Experience building AI capabilities for SaaS products. Key Success Measures Successful delivery of Titan's AI roadmap and AI-powered product capabilities. Delivery of high-quality, scalable, secure and reliable AI solutions. Strong adoption and measurable business value from AI capabilities across Titan products. Effective leadership, engagement and capability development of the AI Engineering team. Continuous improvement in AI engineering standards, governance and best practices.

title: Product Manager (Japanese Required)
description: Purpose and Objective At Money Forward Vietnam, a Product Manager is “Someone who does whatever it takes for the success of the product.” As an AI-Native Associate Product Manager , you are the driver of product execution and a "Mini-CEO" of your assigned scope. Your mission is to master the Product Management Triangle (Engineering, Business, and User) and leverage AI to bridge the gap between non-verbalized user pain points and high-fidelity technical requirements. You are responsible for navigating complex legal and operational constraints to ensure our products deliver world-class value. About This Role: Responsibilities Absolute Ownership: You own the success of your assigned product area. You identify gaps between departments and proactively resolve issues outside the traditional scope to move the product forward. Cross-Functional Synergy (Sales & CS): You serve as the primary bridge between the product and the front office. You work closely with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure they are fully equipped to deliver the product's value. You provide expert-level support by addressing complex product inquiries and translating technical capabilities into business benefits. High-Fidelity PRD Development: You translate guidance from Lead PdMs and identified user needs into comprehensive PRDs from scratch. You drive the development process and ensure the output meets the "Money Forward" standard of excellence. Domain Structuring: You move beyond "Domain Knowledge" to "Domain Understanding." You are expected to define the absolute boundaries and legal/operational constraints of complex back-office workflows. Hypothesis-Driven Development: You utilize the "Demo First" approach. Instead of passive interviewing, you present high-fidelity hypotheses and prototypes to stakeholders and customers to extract true, non-verbalized insights. AI Management: You integrate AI tools into your workflow for deep data analysis and to translate vague requirements into high-resolution technical specifications for the engineering team.
requirements: Core Competencies (The Triangle) User/Domain: Ability to structure complex operations (Finance, Accounting, HR). You must be able to explain the why behind a requirement, not just the what . Business & Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate with Sales and CS. You act as the product advocate, ensuring that feedback from the field is funneled back into the roadmap while providing the clarity the business side needs to succeed. AI & Technical Execution: You utilize AI tools to analyze data and translate vague requirements into high-resolution specifications. You lead the Agile development cycle by effectively communicating business and user constraints to engineers, ensuring the final output aligns perfectly with the strategic product vision. Minimum Qualifications ~3 years of experience as a Product Manager, Business Analyst, or in a high-impact architectural role within the Fintech/SaaS sector. Track Record of Ownership: Demonstrated ability to drive projects to completion by taking initiative beyond the standard job description. Strategic Reverse-Calculation: Ability to visualize the "Final Goal" of a product and work backward to define the necessary steps, avoiding the trap of incremental "stacking." Global Communication: Professional fluency in English . Japanese Language Skills (JLPT N2 or higher): Essential for understanding the nuances of Japanese back-office constraints and influencing stakeholders in a multinational environment. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience with ERP, HR, or Accounting systems for SMEs or growth-stage companies. Performance Expectations & Career Growth Success in this role is measured by your ability to evolve from guided execution to independent leadership. You are expected to: Initiate: Proactively propose additional features based on a clear understanding of why a specific function is required at a specific timing. Self-Direct: Transition to identifying product needs and initiating PRDs from necessity without senior follow-up. Support & Empower: Become the go-to expert for Sales and CS, reducing friction in the sales cycle and onboarding process through deep product knowledge and responsive communication. The "Money Forward" Mindset We are looking for product "craftsmen" with the tenacity to commit to a product’s long-term evolution. If you aim to build the No. 1 Product Management team in the global SaaS industry and hold yourself to the highest standards of execution, we want to talk to you.

title: Solution Architect Expert (Finance)
description: One Mount is Vietnam's largest technological ecosystem that creates solutions along the entire value chain, starting with retail, distribution, real estate, and financial services. Our mission is to build Vietnam's most trusted ecosystem, empowering all people and businesses to realize their full potential at the intersection of technology and humanity. We are looking for an innovative and experienced Solution Architect to lead the design and implementation of scalable, resilient, and secure architectures for our fintech platforms. This role plays a key part in shaping the technical vision and system blueprint for digital financial services. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that architecture decisions align with business goals, technological capabilities, and long-term scalability. RESPONSIBILITIES Bridge multiple business domains by translating complex, cross-functional business requirements into high-quality, cohesive, and secure architectural solutions. Collaborate closely with customers and a diverse set of stakeholders (Product, Business, Security, Data, and Engineering) to develop comprehensive technology products and ensure shared buy-in within a highly matrixed environment. Navigate ambiguity effectively, bringing technical clarity and strong communication to complex, evolving business challenges. Design and maintain the overall architecture of applications, focusing on scalable, resilient, and event-driven distributed systems. Architect and oversee data pipelines, effectively bridging application architecture with large-scale data processing and data engineering. Lead system improvement initiatives and mentor development teams in building high-throughput systems, identifying technical debt, and proposing architectural refactoring. Champion engineering excellence by driving the adoption of robust observability, automated cloud infrastructure, and reliable deployment practices. Explore and introduce emerging technologies (including AI/ML integrations) and advanced software design methodologies (like DDD) to improve platform capabilities. Evaluate the business impact of technical decisions, ensuring architectures meet stringent regulatory compliance, real-time data needs, and security standards.
requirements: Must-Have (The Core Foundation) Experience: 7+ years in software engineering and system architecture, demonstrating a progression of technical leadership. Customer & Matrix Engagement: Demonstrated experience working with customers to develop comprehensive technology solutions or products in a highly matrixed environment. Communication & Ambiguity: Strong ability to communicate effectively and operate decisively in an ambiguous, fast-paced setting. End-to-End Solutioning: Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into cohesive technical solutions, successfully integrating disparate systems, third-party APIs, and data pipelines into a unified architecture. Architecture & Design: Proven track record designing and building scalable, resilient distributed systems (microservices, event-driven architectures). Data Architecture & Database Mastery: Deep understanding of modern data architecture, large-scale data processing, and bridging application architecture with data engineering. Experience with relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases. Core Tech Stack: Strong expertise in enterprise Java (Spring Boot, WebFlux) and designing high-throughput, low-latency systems. Cloud & Platform Engineering: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (or equivalent AWS/Azure) and modern container orchestration (GKE). Hands-on knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm), and modern observability/telemetry tools. Bonus (The "Unicorn" Traits) AI/ML Integration: Experience integrating AI/ML models, LLMs, or working with advanced data ecosystem tools (like Vertex AI or BigQuery) in production applications. Methodology: Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to map complex business requirements into software components. Domain Expertise: Direct experience in fintech or digital platform environments, including familiarity with strict regulatory compliance, real-time data streaming, and security standards (PCI-DSS, OAuth2). Education: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

title: Middle/Senior SOC Platform Engineer (SIEM/SOAR)
description: a. Triển khai và vận hành nền tảng SOC Thiết kế, triển khai và vận hành nền tảng SOC phục vụ giám sát an toàn thông tin cho hệ thống server, endpoint, network, cloud, application và dịch vụ nội bộ. Triển khai, cấu hình và vận hành các giải pháp SOC như Wazuh SIEM/XDR, Shuffle SOAR, TheHive, Cortex, ELK/OpenSearch . Xây dựng kiến trúc thu thập log từ nhiều nguồn: Linux, Windows, firewall, IDS/IPS, VPN, proxy, web server, database, cloud service, application log và endpoint agent. Cấu hình log pipeline, parser, decoder, index, dashboard và alerting rule để phục vụ phát hiện sự kiện bảo mật. Tích hợp SIEM với SOAR, case management, ticketing, email, chat, firewall, EDR/XDR hoặc các hệ thống nội bộ thông qua API/webhook. Đảm bảo hệ thống SOC hoạt động ổn định, có khả năng mở rộng, dễ bảo trì và hỗ trợ phân tích sự cố. b. Detection Engineering và tối ưu rule/content Xây dựng, cập nhật và tối ưu detection rule, correlation rule, alert logic, dashboard, use case giám sát . Tinh chỉnh rule nhằm giảm false positive, cải thiện chất lượng cảnh báo và tăng khả năng phát hiện hành vi tấn công. Phát triển detection content cho các kịch bản như brute force, malware, phishing, suspicious login, privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, data exfiltration, suspicious PowerShell, command & control. Mapping detection use case theo MITRE ATT&CK, IOC, TTP, Cyber Kill Chain . Phân tích log thực tế để đánh giá hiệu quả rule, điều chỉnh threshold, whitelist, blacklist, suppression và enrichment logic. Xây dựng dashboard theo từng nhóm use case: authentication, endpoint, network, web attack, cloud, vulnerability, compliance và incident tracking. Định kỳ review rule/content để loại bỏ rule không hiệu quả, bổ sung rule mới và cải thiện mức độ bao phủ detection. c. SOAR automation và incident workflow Xây dựng và duy trì SOAR playbook/runbook cho các kịch bản xử lý sự cố. Tích hợp Wazuh/SIEM với Shuffle SOAR và TheHive để tự động hóa quy trình tạo case, enrichment IOC, phân loại cảnh báo và điều phối xử lý sự cố. Tự động hóa các bước như kiểm tra IP/domain/hash, tra cứu threat intelligence, gửi cảnh báo, tạo ticket, block IP/domain, disable account, isolate endpoint hoặc yêu cầu xác minh từ system/network team. Thiết kế workflow xử lý sự cố theo mức độ nghiêm trọng: Low, Medium, High, Critical. Phối hợp với SOC Analyst, System, Network, DevOps, Cloud và Application team trong quá trình điều tra, containment và khắc phục sự cố. Theo dõi các chỉ số vận hành như alert volume, false positive rate, MTTA, MTTR, case SLA và đề xuất cải tiến. d. Điều tra sự cố và cải tiến vận hành SOC Hỗ trợ phân tích cảnh báo, xác minh sự kiện, xây dựng timeline và điều tra nguyên nhân gốc của sự cố. Thực hiện threat hunting dựa trên log, IOC, TTP và hành vi bất thường trong hệ thống. Viết báo cáo kỹ thuật, báo cáo sự cố, post-incident review và đề xuất biện pháp phòng ngừa. Xây dựng tài liệu triển khai, tài liệu vận hành, playbook, checklist và hướng dẫn sử dụng cho SOC team. Nghiên cứu, đánh giá và tích hợp thêm các giải pháp open-source hoặc commercial trong hệ sinh thái SOC.
requirements: Có 2–4 năm kinh nghiệm trong các lĩnh vực SOC, SIEM/Security Engineering, Incident Response hoặc Network/System Security. Có kinh nghiệm triển khai, vận hành SIEM/SOAR (ưu tiên Wazuh, ELK/OpenSearch, Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, Shuffle SOAR, TheHive/Cortex). Có khả năng xây dựng và tối ưu detection/correlation rules, dashboard, alert , phân tích log và xử lý sự cố bảo mật. Hiểu biết về Linux, Windows, TCP/IP, Firewall, IDS/IPS, Endpoint Security và các kỹ thuật tấn công theo MITRE ATT&CK . Có kỹ năng scripting/automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell hoặc API/Webhook) và tích hợp các giải pháp bảo mật. Có kinh nghiệm với các nền tảng Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, ELK/OpenSearch là một lợi thế. Ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm trong ngân hàng, fintech, MSSP hoặc sở hữu các chứng chỉ như Security+, CySA+, CEH, GCIH, SC-200, Splunk, Elastic hoặc tương đương.

title: Data Engineer, Global E-commerce Data Platform
location: Quận Hai Bà Trưng, Hà Nội
description: ABOUT THE ROLE Join our Technology Innovations Center of Excellence (CoE) at Crossian , a fast-growing startup that achieved a milestone of $100M in 2024 . In this dynamic role, you'll check in daily with your team to stay aligned on project goals and collaborate across our ecosystem with an Agile mindset infused with a unicorn-worthy startup culture . We operate a production E-commerce Data Platform on AWS Cloud , built on a modern lakehouse-style architecture with Airflow orchestration on Kubernetes (Amazon EKS) , dbt , Apache Iceberg on Amazon S3 , AWS Glue , and Athena . The platform has been running in production for over a year and is now in an active phase of expanding features and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost . You'll help us scale ingestion, harden pipelines, and apply best practices across data domains such as Storefront, Payment Gateway, Inventory, Catalog, Logistics, Marketing and Ads Performance, CRM, Finance, and Customer Support. WHAT YOU WILL DO Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to collect, clean, and process large-scale datasets in the Data Platform , with a strong focus on building new pipelines to ingest data from third-party sources . Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Analysts , and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and develop data solutions for analytics, reporting, and AI/ML. Build and optimize the data architecture of the Data Platform on AWS S3 with Apache Iceberg , supporting both batch and streaming data processing, including opportunities to apply and tune streaming technologies such as RisingWave . Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline issues to ensure data integrity and timely delivery. Utilize tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, and AWS CloudWatch to track logs and send alerts via Slack. Document technical processes, manage metadata with OpenMetadata, maintain data catalogs, and ensure compliance with data governance policies. Use Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence) or Slack for work management and team collaboration. Optimize the performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of the Data Platform . Enhance the scalability and efficiency of all components, including dbt, Airflow, PostgreSQL, AWS S3, and orchestration frameworks. Continuously research and implement new technologies to optimize the current system, applying best practices in Data Engineering and DataOps.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. 4+ years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or a similar role. Proficiency in using advanced SQL queries to extract valuable insights from datasets. Strong proficiency in Python for data processing and scripting. Hands-on experience with dbt and Airflow for data transformation and workflow orchestration, including running Airflow on Kubernetes (AWS EKS) . Experience with core AWS data and cloud services such as S3, Glue, Athena, and Lake Formation. Knowledge of container orchestration with Kubernetes or AWS EKS , including deploying and operating containerized, microservice-based workloads. Proficiency with Git and version-controlled, collaborative development workflows. Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or MS SQL Server. Knowledge of data architecture concepts and cloud-based storage solutions. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly in an Agile environment . Proficient in English , with the ability to communicate, read, and write effectively in a professional work environment. Preferred (but not required) Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps-based CI/CD workflows . Experience with performance and cost optimization on AWS . Experience with data streaming platforms . Java is a plus for streaming workloads. Experience with microservice architecture . Familiarity with data integration from various sources, such as web services, APIs, and file systems. Familiarity with the Agile toolset, such as GitLab, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
description: Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with . Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to. You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work. Why This Role Exists We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer. The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat. What You Will Do Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself. Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits. Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten. Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix. Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit. Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted. Who You Are You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you. High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start. Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts. Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you. Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully. Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.
requirements: Your Toolbox We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week. What We Expect at This Level 6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained. Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here. Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher. Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation. Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one. Not Suitable for the Role If… You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build. You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes. You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger. You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product. You are looking for a maintenance role on a finished platform.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager — Healthcare Platform
description: Context: Nexlab is building an AI-First hospital platform for an international general hospital in HCMC — patient app, self-service kiosk, doctor assist tools, deeply integrated with the Hospital Information System (HIS). We operate in a lean team model with AI tooling throughout the process: one person owns the entire feature lifecycle from idea to spec to design handed off to dev. This position is not a coordinating PM — you are the product creator and the HIS business point of contact for the project. Job Description: A. Product - Own roadmap and backlog according to release milestones: decide which features go into which version, what gets delayed behind feature flags, based on actual HIS integration capabilities and the hospital's operational readiness. - Define product behavior for AI features: suggestion vs. decision boundaries, medical staff approval flows, handling AI uncertainty. - Balance patient experience, hospital operations, and digital health legal constraints; present trade-offs for informed decision making by management. B. HIS & Integration - Act as the business point of contact with the HIS vendor: finalize API lists, verify integration documentation, UAT each endpoint according to actual medical examination processes. - Design and monitor transition operations: supervised manual entry flows running in parallel with API integration, criteria for switching each flow to automatic. - Manage HIS vendor dependency risks: track API delivery commitments, activate backup plans when delayed, report schedule impact. C. Business Analysis - Write PRD and acceptance criteria deep enough for devs to build immediately, without a middle BA layer: mapping medical processes, data flows for reception – queues – lab test indications – results – billing – health insurance, edge cases, error states. - Coordinate UAT with medical staff (doctors, nurses, cashiers, receptionists); transform clinical feedback into controlled spec changes. D. Design - Create UX flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity screens within the project's locked design system — no reinventing visual language, but must produce complete screens for dev handoff with behavioral specs. - Design QA on builds: compare implementation against design, including animation, empty/error states, Vietnamese UI content. - Design for specific contexts: elderly patients on touch kiosks, medical staff operating quickly during shifts, personal information on public screens.
requirements: Requirements: Mandatory: - 5+ years in software product management, with at least 2 years in healthcare or hospital projects in Vietnam. - Direct experience working with at least one popular HIS in Vietnam (HSoft, FPT.eHospital, VNPT HIS, Viettel HIS, or equivalent) in integration, deployment, or business analysis roles; understand outpatient workflow and health insurance billing; capable of reading HL7/FHIR, ICD-10 at a working level. - Have shipped products to production where you personally wrote specs and designed screens — proven by portfolio, "coordinating with design/BA teams" is not accepted. - Technical foundation sufficient to work directly with devs and architects: read API docs, understand microservices, distinguish real technical limits from implementation limits. - Proficient in AI tooling in daily workflow (Claude/ChatGPT for specs and research, AI design tools) — an operational requirement, not a plus. - Made scope cut/delay decisions under deadline pressure and defended them to senior stakeholders. - Good English for reading technical documentation. Nice to have: - Participated in system go-live at an operating hospital (without stopping patient intake). - Experience with multi-touchpoint products (app + kiosk + web) sharing a data foundation. - Experience with products containing AI/LLM components in production; understand personal data protection regulations in healthcare in Vietnam. - Able to use both Figma and design-to-code tools; understand design tokens and component systems.

Sử dụng tốt ReactJS hoặc Angular ở mức phát triển tính năng hoàn chỉnh. Nắm vững OOP, RESTful API, SQL (PostgreSQL hoặc SQL Server). Hiểu và áp dụng được các design pattern thông dụng; có khái niệm về Clean Architecture. Đã sử dụng Docker ở mức cơ bản (build image, docker-compose). Biết sử dụng hoặc sẵn sàng học cách dùng AI coding assistant (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Antigravity…) trong công việc. Sử dụng thành thạo Git. Ưu tiên / Là lợi thế Kinh nghiệm với RabbitMQ hoặc Redis. Kinh nghiệm phát triển Mobile (React Native, Flutter, .NET MAUI) hoặc Desktop (WinForms/WPF). Kinh nghiệm với Ant Design. Biết thiết lập AI Agent, prompt engineering nâng cao, hoặc xây dựng workflow tự động với AI. Đã từng tham gia xây dựng quy trình CI/CD cho tổ chức/công ty. Kiến thức về Linux, GitLab CI/CD, Biết về Kubernetes là lợi thế. Kiến thức mạng cơ bản (TCP/IP) phục vụ tích hợp thiết bị. Tố chất và kỹ năng mềm Product mindset: chủ động tìm hiểu nghiệp vụ, quan tâm đến trải nghiệm người dùng cuối và giá trị sản phẩm mang lại, không dừng ở việc hoàn thành task được giao. Tinh thần trách nhiệm với phần việc của mình, sẵn sàng đề xuất cải tiến tính năng. Tinh thần tự học, chủ động cập nhật công nghệ mới, không ngại thử sai. Trách nhiệm với chất lượng sản phẩm và tiến độ. Giao tiếp hiệu quả, tư duy logic, kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề tốt.

title: Senior IT Governance (ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
description: About Timo Launched in 2015, Timo pioneered digital banking in Vietnam with a mission to make banking faster, simpler, and more accessible. Today, as part of one of Southeast Asia’s leading digital financial services platforms, Timo is building secure, scalable, and customer-first digital banking experiences for millions of users across Vietnam. We are looking for curious minds and driven talents from fintech, digital banking, and technology companies who are excited to move fast, build meaningful products, and help shape the future of banking in Vietnam. About the Role We are looking for a Senior IT GRC to assist in driving a robust Governance, Risk, and Compliance framework across Timo and Kredivo Group. description: About Yum! Our story might surprise you. We connect customers with our brands through apps, websites, kiosks, point-of-sale systems, and other digital dining experiences. Behind those experiences is a growing ecosystem of data, artificial intelligence, and machine learning solutions that support restaurant operations and customer engagement around the world. Job Summary We are seeking an experienced AI Support Engineer with a Machine Learning Engineering focus to join our 24/7 AI operations team. This role is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and improving production machine learning platforms, pipelines, APIs, and deployment environments. The engineer will independently investigate complex operational issues, coordinate incident response, and partner with Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, platform teams, and cloud engineering teams to restore service and improve system reliability. In addition to responding to incidents, this role will help strengthen the operational maturity of our AI ecosystem by developing automation, improving observability, refining support processes, and identifying recurring issues that should be addressed through engineering changes. The successful candidate will have hands-on experience supporting cloud-based production systems and will be comfortable operating across machine learning, infrastructure, software engineering, and DevOps domains. Key Responsibilities Production Operations and Reliability Monitor and support production machine learning pipelines, inference services, APIs, feature-processing workflows, and deployment environments. Independently diagnose and resolve moderately complex issues involving model inference, data dependencies, deployment failures, service availability, latency, capacity, and infrastructure performance. Assess the operational impact and urgency of production issues and take appropriate action to restore services. Perform detailed root cause analyses for incidents, document findings, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Identify recurring failure patterns and partner with engineering teams to implement permanent solutions. Support production readiness reviews and validate that new AI and machine learning services meet operational support requirements before release. Participate in an on-call rotation supporting a 24/7 production environment. Incident and Problem Management Serve as a primary responder for AI- and MLE-related incidents identified through monitoring platforms, automated alerts, or user reports. Lead or coordinate the technical investigation of incidents within the role’s area of responsibility. Engage appropriate engineering, data, infrastructure, and vendor teams when cross-functional support is required. Maintain clear communication during incidents, including impact, status, mitigation actions, and expected next steps. Ensure incidents are tracked through resolution and that follow-up actions are documented and completed. Analyze operational metrics such as mean time to acknowledge, mean time to resolution, incident volume, availability, and recurring failure categories. Provide recommendations to improve reliability, supportability, and incident response effectiveness. Deployment and Platform Support Support CI/CD workflows used to test, package, deploy, and promote machine learning models and AI services. Troubleshoot issues involving containers, Kubernetes workloads, cloud resources, infrastructure-as-code deployments, configuration, networking, permissions, and service dependencies. Assist with model and platform releases, including deployment validation, rollback support, and post-release monitoring. Partner with Machine Learning Engineers to improve deployment patterns, environment consistency, scalability, and recoverability. Help manage production configurations, operational dependencies, and service-level requirements across development, staging, and production environments. Automation and Continuous Improvement Design and implement scripts, utilities, and automated workflows that reduce manual support effort and improve response times. Automate common operational activities such as service recovery, endpoint scaling, health validation, deployment checks, log collection, and resource-management tasks. Improve monitoring, logging, dashboards, alerts, and operational telemetry to provide earlier identification of production issues. Develop and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, support procedures, and operational playbooks. Recommend improvements to architecture, tooling, processes, and support models based on operational experience. Contribute to reliability, resilience, capacity-planning, and disaster-recovery initiatives for AI and machine learning services. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Machine Learning Engineers to support the deployment, maintenance, and optimization of production models and machine learning infrastructure. Collaborate with Data Scientists and AI Engineers to ensure new solutions are supportable, observable, and production ready. Work with cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity, data engineering, and enterprise support teams to resolve issues spanning multiple technology domains. Provide technical guidance to junior support engineers and assist with knowledge transfer, troubleshooting practices, and operational procedures. Communicate complex technical issues clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
requirements: Qualifications Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Two or more years of experience in machine learning engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, cloud engineering, software production support, or AI system operations. Experience independently supporting business-critical applications or services in a production environment. Strong working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure. Hands-on experience with container technologies and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with machine learning platforms or MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker, or Azure Machine Learning. Proficiency with Python and SQL for troubleshooting, scripting, data investigation, and automation. Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies. Ability to investigate application logs, infrastructure metrics, distributed systems failures, data-quality issues, and service dependencies. Experience with incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, and production change management practices. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and make sound technical decisions in a fast-paced, 24/7 support environment. Ability to participate in an on-call rotation, including occasional support outside standard business hours. Preferred Qualifications Experience with monitoring, observability, and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk, Cloud Monitoring, or CloudWatch. Experience developing production-quality automation using Python, Bash, or another scripting language. Understanding the complete machine learning lifecycle, including data preparation, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and retirement. Experience supporting real-time inference services, batch-scoring pipelines, generative AI applications, or AI agents. Familiarity with service-level indicators, service-level objectives, error budgets, and site reliability engineering practices. Experience with model monitoring, data drift, model drift, performance degradation, and AI-specific operational risks. Familiarity with secure software development practices, identity and access management, secrets management, and cloud security controls. Experience mentoring junior engineers or leading technical incident investigations. Experience supporting globally distributed systems, teams, or customers.

Phối hợp chặt chẽ với đội Development và Product Management để đảm bảo quy trình QA được tích hợp liền mạch.. Trao đổi hiệu quả với các bên liên quan, cập nhật về hoạt động QA, rủi ro và tình trạng chất lượng sản phẩm. QUYỀN LỢI Lương cạnh tranh Nhận 100% lương trong 2 tháng thử việc 12 ngày phép năm cộng thêm 1 ngày nghỉ sinh nhật có lương Bảo hiểm xã hội, y tế, thất nghiệp theo quy định pháp luật Đánh giá hiệu suất hàng năm và cơ hội phát triển sự nghiệp Môi trường startup năng động, thân thiện Tham gia các hoạt động công ty: team-building, workshop, sự kiện
requirements: YÊU CẦU Bắt buộc: Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, Kỹ thuật hoặc lĩnh vực liên quan. Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm kiểm thử Web Services và ứng dụng Mobile. Kinh nghiệm xây dựng test case, thực thi test và báo cáo kết quả. Có kinh nghiệm thực hành Shift-Left Testing , bao gồm tham gia sớm vào phân tích yêu cầu, review thiết kế và lập kế hoạch test. Kinh nghiệm vững về System Integration Testing (SIT) để kiểm thử luồng nghiệp vụ end-to-end và các điểm tích hợp giữa services, API và hệ thống bên thứ ba. Quen thuộc với môi trường Agile/SCRUM. Kỹ năng giao tiếp tốt trong các dự án phát triển. Am hiểu sâu rộng về phương pháp luận, công cụ và quy trình QA/QC cho ứng dụng web và mobile. Khả năng quản lý và tối ưu quy trình QA/QC trong môi trường Agile/SCRUM. Nice-to-have: Giao tiếp tiếng Anh tốt. Kinh nghiệm về Security testing hoặc Performance testing. Khả năng nghiên cứu và cập nhật công nghệ mới. Từng làm việc tại các công ty liên quan đến phát triển web. Kỹ năng lãnh đạo và cố vấn để dẫn dắt đội ngũ QA/QC là điểm cộng.

title: Backend Engineer (Java, NodeJS, TypeScript) - Fintech
description: Core Responsibilities Thiết kế, phát triển và duy trì các backend services/API phục vụ các sản phẩm fintech, dữ liệu tài chính và nền tảng nội bộ của Finhay; Xây dựng các RESTful API/GraphQL API có tính ổn định, bảo mật, dễ mở rộng và dễ tích hợp với các hệ thống khác; Phát triển các business logic liên quan đến dữ liệu tài chính, tài khoản người dùng, giao dịch, báo cáo, tích hợp đối tác và các luồng nghiệp vụ nội bộ; Tối ưu hiệu năng hệ thống, database query, caching, queue/job processing và khả năng chịu tải của backend services; Tham gia thiết kế kiến trúc hệ thống, data model, luồng xử lý nghiệp vụ và giải pháp kỹ thuật cho các tính năng mới; Phối hợp với Product Owner, QA, DevOps, Data và các team liên quan để phân tích yêu cầu, triển khai, debug và vận hành sản phẩm; Đảm bảo chất lượng code thông qua unit test, integration test, code review, logging, monitoring và tài liệu kỹ thuật; Maintain một số project nhỏ sử dụng Node.js khi cần, bao gồm fix bug, nâng cấp dependency, đọc hiểu source code và hỗ trợ vận hành. System Integration & Data Products Tích hợp với các hệ thống nội bộ và bên thứ ba như API đối tác, hệ thống dữ liệu tài chính, payment, notification, authentication/authorization; Làm việc với dữ liệu tài chính như market data, stock quotes, financial statements, fund NAV, indices hoặc các loại dữ liệu liên quan đến sản phẩm đầu tư; Thiết kế cơ chế validate, transform, đồng bộ và xử lý dữ liệu đảm bảo tính chính xác, nhất quán và kịp thời; Hỗ trợ phân tích nguyên nhân lỗi liên quan đến API responses, data pipeline, latency, timeout, data inconsistency hoặc production incidents; Đề xuất cải tiến kiến trúc, chất lượng dữ liệu, developer experience và hiệu quả vận hành hệ thống.
requirements: Technical Skills (Required) Tối thiểu 2 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển backend bằng Java; Thành thạo Java Core và có kinh nghiệm thực tế với Spring Boot/Spring Framework; Có kinh nghiệm thiết kế và phát triển RESTful API, hiểu rõ HTTP methods, status codes, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, pagination; Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với database quan hệ như PostgreSQL/MySQL/MariaDB; hiểu SQL, index, transaction, query optimization; Có kiến thức về caching, message queue hoặc background jobs là lợi thế: Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS hoặc tương đương; Có kinh nghiệm viết unit test/integration test và quen thuộc với các công cụ như JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers hoặc tương đương; Quen thuộc với Git, CI/CD, Docker và quy trình phát triển phần mềm theo Agile/Scrum; Có khả năng đọc hiểu, maintain và chỉnh sửa các project nhỏ bằng Node.js/JavaScript/TypeScript khi cần. Không yêu cầu là chuyên gia Node.js, nhưng cần sẵn sàng học và xử lý vấn đề ngoài Java stack. Technical Skills (Strong Plus) Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng hệ thống fintech, securities, banking, payment, trading, market data hoặc các sản phẩm có yêu cầu cao về độ chính xác dữ liệu; Hiểu biết về microservices, event-driven architecture, distributed system, observability, logging/metrics/tracing; Có kinh nghiệm với cloud/on-prem deployment, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform hoặc các công cụ vận hành hệ thống là lợi thế; Có kinh nghiệm tối ưu performance, xử lý high-throughput API, batch processing hoặc data synchronization; Có hiểu biết về security best practices: OWASP, secure coding, secrets management, token-based authentication, OAuth2/JWT. Domain Knowledge (Strong Plus) Có hiểu biết về thị trường tài chính, chứng khoán, quỹ đầu tư, dữ liệu tài chính hoặc các chỉ số như P/E, EPS, ROE, NAV, market cap là lợi thế lớn; Quen thuộc với các loại dữ liệu tài chính như stock quotes, financial statements, fund NAV, indices, commodities hoặc dữ liệu giao dịch; Kinh nghiệm làm việc tại công ty fintech, chứng khoán, ngân hàng, dữ liệu tài chính hoặc sản phẩm B2B API là điểm cộng. AI Mindset & Application Chủ động sử dụng AI tools như ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot hoặc các coding assistant khác để tăng hiệu suất công việc hàng ngày; Biết ứng dụng AI vào quy trình phát triển phần mềm: phân tích yêu cầu, gợi ý thiết kế API, sinh test cases, hỗ trợ viết/refactor code, phân tích log, debug lỗi và viết tài liệu kỹ thuật; Có khả năng đánh giá kết quả do AI tạo ra, biết kiểm chứng bằng test, code review và hiểu biết kỹ thuật thay vì phụ thuộc máy móc; Tư duy cởi mở với công nghệ mới, không bị cố định vào một tech stack duy nhất; sẵn sàng học công nghệ phù hợp để giải quyết bài toán thực tế. Analytical & Soft Skills Tư duy phân tích tốt, có khả năng hiểu nghiệp vụ, bóc tách vấn đề và đưa ra giải pháp kỹ thuật phù hợp; Cẩn thận, có trách nhiệm với chất lượng hệ thống, đặc biệt khi làm việc với dữ liệu tài chính và các luồng nghiệp vụ nhạy cảm; Chủ động giao tiếp, phối hợp tốt với PO, QA, DevOps, Data và các stakeholders khác; Có tinh thần ownership, sẵn sàng debug production issues và follow-through đến khi vấn đề được xử lý triệt để; Khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật bằng tiếng Anh; Flexible trong công nghệ, ưu tiên giải quyết vấn đề và tạo giá trị cho sản phẩm hơn là chỉ làm việc trong một framework/ngôn ngữ quen thuộc. Chúng tôi kỳ vọng ở bạn Là một backend engineer có nền tảng Java vững, nhưng không “đóng khung” trong Java; Có khả năng xây dựng API/backend service ổn định, bảo mật, dễ maintain; Có tinh thần học nhanh, thích nghi tốt với các project legacy hoặc project nhỏ dùng công nghệ khác như Node.js; Biết tận dụng AI một cách thực tế để làm việc nhanh hơn, chất lượng hơn và giảm các tác vụ lặp lại; Quan tâm đến chất lượng dữ liệu, hiệu năng hệ thống và trải nghiệm của end-users/developers sử dụng API.

title: Project Manager (PMO)
description: 1. Enterprise Project Management Framework Governance Lead the design, implementation, and continuous enhancement of the Bank’s enterprise-wide project management framework, including governance policies, methodologies, processes, monitoring mechanisms, and supporting tools. Establish, maintain, and continuously improve project management standards, procedures, guidelines, templates, and governance documentation to ensure consistency and effectiveness across the Bank. Ensure alignment of project governance practices with the Bank’s strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. 2. Enterprise Project Portfolio Management Oversee the Bank’s project portfolio and coordinate the development, prioritization, and adjustment of the enterprise project roadmap. Evaluate and challenge new project proposals to ensure alignment with the Bank’s strategic priorities, resource capacity, and project governance requirements. Monitor portfolio performance, project interdependencies, resource allocation, and strategic alignment across initiatives. Proactively identify portfolio-level risks, conflicts, bottlenecks, and underperforming projects, and recommend corrective actions and escalation measures when necessary. Provide portfolio insights, reporting, and recommendations to senior management to support decision-making. 3. Strategic Project Leadership and Oversight Directly manage strategic and high-priority projects assigned by the Bank, ensuring successful delivery within approved scope, timeline, budget, and quality standards. Serve as the primary point of contact (SPOC) for Project Sponsors, Steering Committees, and key stakeholders. Lead project planning, execution, monitoring, risk management, issue resolution, and change management activities. Escalate critical issues and risks appropriately while driving timely decision-making and resolution. Ensure project teams comply with PMO governance standards, methodologies, processes, and reporting requirements. Maintain comprehensive and accurate project documentation, records, and audit trails. Identify recurring project challenges and systemic issues and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the project management ecosystem. 4. Project Management Capability Development and Knowledge Management Establish and manage enterprise knowledge management practices, including the collection, documentation, and dissemination of lessons learned and best practices. Promote a culture of project management excellence across the Bank. Partner with Human Resources and business units to identify capability gaps and develop project management competency-building programs. Support the professional development of project managers and project teams through coaching, mentoring, training, and governance guidance. Drive the adoption of project management methodologies, tools, and best practices throughout the organization.
requirements: Qualifications and Requirements 1. Education Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Finance and Banking, Economics, or related disciplines. Possession of reputable international certifications, particularly in Project Management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-PgMP, PMI-PMOCP), is an advantage. 2. Knowledge and Experience Minimum of 7 years of professional working experience. Experience in the Financial Services or Banking industry, or participation in transformation programs, system implementation projects, or the development of internal governance frameworks and policies for financial institutions. Experience in a similar role or with leading international consulting firms is highly desirable. 3. Professional Competencies and Skills Portfolio Management capability. Project Management capability. Governance, Systems, and Tools Management capability. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
